  summarise(n_surveys = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%

### Acoustic

### adding ats_year and trawl_month
trip_effort_sockeye_stickle <- trip_effort_sockeye_stickle %>%
  mutate(trawl_date = ymd(trawl_date),
    trawl_month = month(trawl_date)) 

# Month abbreviation

# Filter only the lakes of interest
trip_effort_sockeye_stickle <- trip_effort_sockeye_stickle %>%
  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest) %>%
  distinct(ats_year, lake_name, Trip, trawl_month) 

# Create histograms for each loi
lakes <- trip_effort_sockeye_stickle %>%
  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest)
lakes <- unique(lakes$lake_name)

ggplot(
  trip_effort_sockeye_stickle,
  aes(
    x = factor(
      trawl_month,
      levels = c("Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep",
                 "Oct", "Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar")),
    fill = factor(ats_year,
                  levels = sort(unique(ats_year))))) +
  scale_x_discrete(
  breaks = c("Apr", "Jun", "Aug", "Oct", "Dec", "Feb")) +
  geom_bar(
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, 
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
  option = "viridis") +

  labs(
    title = "Key Lakes Trip Frequency by Month and ATS Year",
    x = "",
    y = "Trips",
    fill = "ATS Year") +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE,
                             keywidth = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                             keyheight = unit(0.4, "cm"),)) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size=8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7))

```{r depth-acoustic, fig.cap="Frequency distribution of depth range for acoustic sonar surveys across all lakes.", fig.width=fig_width, out.width=out_width, fig.height=half_height}

unique_depth_acoustic <- fix_lake_codes_names(Acoustic_data_import) %>%
  distinct(depth_min_m, depth_max_m, lake_name, survey_date) %>%
  arrange(depth_min_m) %>%
  mutate(depth_m = paste0(depth_min_m, "-", depth_max_m),
         depth_m = factor(depth_m, levels = unique(depth_m))) 

ggplot(unique_depth_acoustic, aes(x = depth_m)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "purple4", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +  # fill = "#440154"

       subtitle = "All Lakes, All Years",

```{r acoustic-targets, fig.cap="Mean annual fish targets from acoustic sonar surveys by lake and year.", fig.width=fig_width, out.width=out_width, fig.height=half_height}

acoustic_targets <- fix_lake_codes_names(Acoustic_data_import) %>%
# filter(lake_name == "Great Central Lake") %>%
  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest) %>%
  select(ats_year, lake_name, lake_code, survey_date, transect, targets, prop_sockeye)

# Step 1: Sum across depth strata within each transect
acoustic_transect_totals <- acoustic_targets %>%
  group_by(
    lake_name,
    lake_code,
    ats_year,
    survey_date,
    transect
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    transect_targets = sum(targets, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: Sum across transects within each survey
acoustic_survey_totals <- acoustic_transect_totals %>%
  group_by(
    lake_name,
    lake_code,
    ats_year,
    survey_date
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    survey_targets = sum(transect_targets, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
# Step 3: Mean acoustic targets per survey by lake and ATS year 
acoustic_annual_summary <- acoustic_survey_totals %>%
  group_by(
    lake_name,
    lake_code,
    ats_year
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    mean_targets = mean(survey_targets, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_targets = median(survey_targets, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_targets = sd(survey_targets, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Visualize with boxplots 
acoustic_annual_medians <- acoustic_survey_totals %>%
  group_by(
    lake_name,
    ats_year
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    median_targets = median(survey_targets),
   .groups = "drop")


for (lk in sort(unique(acoustic_survey_totals$lake_name))) {
  acoustic_survey_totals_lk <- acoustic_survey_totals %>% 
    filter(lake_name == lk)
  
  acoustic_annual_medians_lk <- acoustic_annual_medians %>%
  filter(lake_name == lk)

  y_max <- min(
  30000,
  quantile(
    acoustic_survey_totals_lk$survey_targets,
    probs = 0.99,
    na.rm = TRUE)) 
  
  p <- ggplot(
    acoustic_survey_totals_lk,
    aes(
      x = factor(ats_year),
      y = survey_targets)) +
    
    geom_boxplot(
      fill = "darkblue",
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3) +
    
    geom_line(
      data = acoustic_annual_medians_lk,
      aes(
        x = factor(ats_year),
        y = median_targets,
        group = 1),
      colour = "red",
      linewidth = 0.5) +
    
    geom_point(
      data = acoustic_annual_medians_lk,
      aes(
        x = factor(ats_year),
        y = median_targets),
      colour = "red",
      size = 1) +
    
    # facet_wrap(
    #   ~ lake_name,
    #   scales = "free_y",
    #   ncol = 4) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1/1000),
      name = "Targets per Survey (1000's)") +
          
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste(lk, "Mean Annual Acoustic Survey Target Counts by ATS Year"),
      subtitle = "Survey-level totals summed across depth strata and transects for key study lakes",
      x = "",
      y = "Targets per Survey") +
    
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 8
      ))
  # strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
  # strip.background = element_rect(
  #   fill = "yellow",
  #   colour = "black",
  #   linewidth = 0.3))
  
  print(p)
}

```

```{r acoustic-data-prop-sox, fig.cap="Annual proportion Sockeye (as recorded in acoustic source files), weighted by target abundance, by lake and year.  Note that these proportions were derived from trawl sample data by observers and applied to the acoustic source data manually, and are presented here for comparative purposes.", fig.width=fig_width, out.width=out_width, fig.height=3.5}

acoustic_survey_prop_sockeye <- acoustic_targets %>%  # aggregate to lake/year/survey level
  group_by(
    lake_name,
    lake_code,
    ats_year,
    survey_date) %>%
  summarise(
    survey_targets = sum(targets, na.rm = TRUE),
    survey_prop_sockeye =
      sum(targets * prop_sockeye, na.rm = TRUE) /  # get weighted mean proportion sockeye
      sum(targets, na.rm = TRUE),                  # weighted by the number of targets
     .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(survey_prop_sockeye))

acoustic_annual_prop_sockeye <- acoustic_survey_prop_sockeye %>%   # calc annual medians
  group_by(
    lake_name,
    ats_year) %>%
  summarise(
    median_prop_sockeye =
      median(survey_prop_sockeye, na.rm = TRUE),
     .groups = "drop")

for (lk in sort(unique(acoustic_survey_prop_sockeye$lake_name))) {

  survey_lk <- acoustic_survey_prop_sockeye %>%
    filter(lake_name == lk)

  annual_lk <- acoustic_annual_prop_sockeye %>%
    filter(lake_name == lk)

  p <- ggplot(
    survey_lk,
    aes(
      x = factor(ats_year),
      y = survey_prop_sockeye)) +

    geom_boxplot(
      fill = "darkblue",
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3) +

    geom_line(
      data = annual_lk,
      aes(
        x = factor(ats_year),
        y = median_prop_sockeye,
        group = 1),
      colour = "red",
      linewidth = 0.5) +

    geom_point(
      data = annual_lk,
      aes(
        x = factor(ats_year),
        y = median_prop_sockeye),
      colour = "red",
      size = 1) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      name = "Sockeye Proportion") +

    labs(
      title = paste(lk,
        "Annual Sockeye Proportions (in Acoustic Files)"),
      subtitle =
        "Survey-level proportions across all depth strata and transects (weighted by targets)",
      x = "",
      y = "Sockeye (%)") +

    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 8))

  print(p)
}

```

```{r duration_distribution, fig.cap="Frequency distribution of trawl duration in minutes (left y-axis) and their proportion in the dataset (right y-axis). Duration represents calculated times from recorded start and stop times where available, otherwise recorded duration time.", fig.width=fig_width, out.width=out_width, fig.height=half_height}

unique_calc_duration <- fix_lake_codes_names(Trawl_data_import) %>%
  distinct(calc_duration_time, trawl_unique_ID, orig_duration_minutes) %>%
  mutate(Duration = case_when(calc_duration_time != orig_duration_minutes ~ calc_duration_time,
                              is.na(calc_duration_time) ~ orig_duration_minutes,
                              is.na(orig_duration_minutes) ~ calc_duration_time,
                              is.na(orig_duration_minutes) & is.na(calc_duration_time) ~ NA_real_,
                              TRUE ~ orig_duration_minutes))

unique_calc_duration <- unique_calc_duration %>%
  filter(!is.na(Duration)) %>%
  group_by(Duration) %>%
  mutate(count = n())

unique_calc_duration$Proportion <- 
  round((unique_calc_duration$count / length(unique_calc_duration$Duration))*100, 2)

# redo above plot with break in y-axis to emphasize lesser bars...
ggplot(unique_calc_duration,
       aes(x = as.integer(Duration))) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    center = 1,
    linewidth = 0.1,
    color = "black",
    fill = "yellow") +  # #FBD424FF (orange-ish)

  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest,
    species_common_name %in% c("Sockeye", "Stickleback")) %>%
  filter(!(species_common_name == "Sockeye" & life_stage == "Adult")) %>%
  rename("Length (mm)" = fish_length_mm, "Weight (g)" = calc_std_weight_g) %>%
  select(lake_name, species_common_name, `Length (mm)`, `Weight (g)`) %>%

# lakes <- unique(df_plot$lake_name)

df_plot_year <- fix_lake_codes_names(Trawl_data_import) %>%
  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest,
    species_common_name %in% c("Sockeye", "Stickleback")) %>%
  filter(!(species_common_name == "Sockeye" & life_stage == "Adult")) %>%
  rename("Length (mm)" = fish_length_mm, "Weight (g)" = calc_std_weight_g) %>%
  select(lake_name, ats_year, species_common_name, `Length (mm)`, `Weight (g)`) %>%

```{r separated-spp, fig.cap="Scatter plot illustrating the relationship between fish length and weight for juvenile Chinook, Coho, Sockeye and all Stickleback specimens included in the dataset. Additionally, a regression curve is also provided, including the annotated coefficients for each species. Any adult Sockeye was disregarded in the statistical calculations. Length–weight relationships were estimated separately for each species using linear regression on log-transformed data. For each species, a linear model of the form W=aLb was fitted, i.e., log(calculated standardized weight) = log(a) + b × log(length). The intercept and slope from the regression were used to calculate the length–weight parameters, where a was obtained by back-transforming the intercept (exp(intercept)) and b represents the scaling coefficient. The sample size (N) was calculated as the number of observations included in each species-specific model, and model fit was assessed using the coefficient of determination (R²).", fig.width=fig_width, out.width=out_width, fig.asp = 0.8}

# Drop any adult codes.
scatter_plot_all_spp_filtered <- fix_lake_codes_names(Trawl_data_import) %>%
  filter(!life_stage %in% c("Gravid female", "Adult", "Adult female")) %>%
  filter(species_common_name %in% c("Coho", "Chinook", "Stickleback", "Sockeye"))

# Clean data
scatter_plot_all_spp_filtered <- scatter_plot_all_spp_filtered %>%
  filter(!is.na(fish_length_mm), !is.na(calc_std_weight_g), fish_length_mm > 0, calc_std_weight_g > 0)

#scatter_plot_all_spp_filtered %>%
#  filter(!is.na(species_common_name)) %>%
#  group_by(species_common_name) %>%
#  summarise(n = n(), unique_lengths = n_distinct(fish_length_mm)) %>%
#  arrange(unique_lengths)

# Fit one model per species
models <- scatter_plot_all_spp_filtered %>%
  group_by(species_common_name) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(model = map(data, ~lm(log(calc_std_weight_g) ~ log(fish_length_mm), data = .x)) )

# Compute statistical variables: a, b, N and R²
stats <- models %>%
  mutate( intercept = map_dbl(model, ~coef(.x)[1]),
          b = map_dbl(model, ~coef(.x)[2]),
          a = exp(intercept),
          R2 = map_dbl(model, ~summary(.x)$r.squared),
          N = map_int(data, nrow)) %>%
  select(species_common_name, a, b, N, R2)

# Create fitted curves
predictions <- models %>%
  mutate(newdata = map(data, ~data.frame(
      fish_length_mm = seq(min(.x$fish_length_mm),
                           max(.x$fish_length_mm),
                           length.out = 200))),
    prediction = map2( model, newdata,~mutate(.y, calc_std_weight_g = exp(predict(.x, newdata = .y))))) %>%
  select(species_common_name, prediction) %>%
  unnest(prediction)

# Create annotation labels
labels <- stats %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("a = ", signif(a, 3),"\n",
                        "b = ", round(b, 3), "\n",
                        "N = ", format(N, big.mark = ","), "\n",
                        "R² = ", round(R2, 3)))

# Plot the scatter plot
ggplot(scatter_plot_all_spp_filtered, aes(fish_length_mm, calc_std_weight_g)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = species_common_name), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = predictions, aes(y = calc_std_weight_g), 
            colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = labels, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  labs(title="Key Fish Species Length/Weight Relations", 
       subtitle="All Lakes, All Years",
       x="Fish length (mm)", y = "Fish weigth (g)", colour = "Species") +
  facet_wrap(~species_common_name, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill   = "yellow", #"#FBD424FF", 
                                    colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "none")

```

```{r sockeye, fig.cap="Sockeye length and weight data for key study lakes. Note that there are some anomalous values for Sockeye Age +1 in Kennedy Lake. These unusual length/weight values are flagged in the trawl biosampling dataset. For Great Central Lake, the Sockeye with long length and light weight are also flagged in the trawl dataset as having unusual sizes.  NOTE: NEED TO FIX ISSUES WITH PREDICTED VALUES [HS 260814]", out.width="90%", fig.height=fig_height, fig.asp = 11.69/8.27}

Trawl_data_sockeye <- fix_lake_codes_names(Trawl_data_import) %>%
  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest) %>%
  filter(species_common_name == "Sockeye") %>%
  filter(!life_stage %in% c("Adult")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fish_length_mm)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fish_weight_g)) %>%
  arrange(lake_name, match(life_stage, c("Fry", "1+")))

# Fit one model per lake
models_lake <- Trawl_data_sockeye %>%
  group_by(lake_name) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(
      data,
      ~ lm(
        log(calc_std_weight_g) ~ log(fish_length_mm),
        data = .x)))

# Calculate model statistics
stats_lake <- models_lake %>%
  mutate(
    intercept = map_dbl(model, ~ coef(.x)[1]),
    b = map_dbl(model, ~ coef(.x)[2]),
    a = exp(intercept),
    R2 = map_dbl(model, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
    N = map_int(data, nrow)
  ) %>%
  select(lake_name, a, b, N, R2)

# Create fitted curves
predictions_lake <- models_lake %>%
  mutate(
    newdata = map(
      data,
      ~ data.frame(
        fish_length_mm = seq(
          min(.x$fish_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
          max(.x$fish_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
          length.out = 200
        ))),
    prediction = map2(
      model,
      newdata,
      ~ {
        pred <- predict(
          .x,
          newdata = .y,
          interval = "confidence")

        cbind(.y, pred) %>%
          mutate(
            fit = exp(fit),
            lwr = exp(lwr),
            upr = exp(upr)
          )})) %>%
  select(lake_name, prediction) %>%
  unnest(prediction)

# Create annotation labels
labels_lake <- stats_lake %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "a = ", signif(a, 3), "\n",
      "b = ", round(b, 3), "\n",
      "N = ", format(N, big.mark = ","), "\n",
      "R² = ", round(R2, 3)))

ggplot(Trawl_data_sockeye, aes(x = fish_length_mm, y = calc_std_weight_g, colour = life_stage)) +

  geom_point(data = subset(Trawl_data_sockeye, life_stage %in% c("1+", "Fry")), alpha = 0.5) +

  geom_line(data = predictions, aes(y = calc_std_weight_g), 
            colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_text(data = labels_lake, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +

  scale_color_manual(name = "Life stage",
                     values = c("Fry" = "lightblue", "1+" = "darkblue")) +

    strip.background = element_rect(fill   = "yellow", #"#FBD424FF",

Trawl_data_filtered_life_stage <- fix_lake_codes_names(Trawl_data_import) %>%
  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest) %>%
  mutate(life_stage2 = ifelse(life_stage != "Adult" & life_stage != "Adult female"
                              & life_stage != "Fry" & life_stage != "Gravid female"
                              & life_stage != "Subadult", "Unspecified", life_stage)) %>%
  filter(species_common_name == "Stickleback") %>%
  arrange(lake_name, match(life_stage2, c("Unspecified", "Subadult", "Fry", "Adult", "Gravid female", "Adult female")))

# Fit one model per lake
models_lake <- Trawl_data_filtered_life_stage %>%
  group_by(lake_name) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(
      data,
      ~ lm(
        log(calc_std_weight_g) ~ log(fish_length_mm),
        data = .x)))

# Calculate model statistics
stats_lake <- models_lake %>%
  mutate(
    intercept = map_dbl(model, ~ coef(.x)[1]),
    b = map_dbl(model, ~ coef(.x)[2]),
    a = exp(intercept),
    R2 = map_dbl(model, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
    N = map_int(data, nrow)
  ) %>%
  select(lake_name, a, b, N, R2)

# Create fitted curves
predictions_lake <- models_lake %>%
  mutate(
    newdata = map(
      data,
      ~ data.frame(
        fish_length_mm = seq(
          min(.x$fish_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
          max(.x$fish_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
          length.out = 200
        ))),
    prediction = map2(
      model,
      newdata,
      ~ {
        pred <- predict(
          .x,
          newdata = .y,
          interval = "confidence")

        cbind(.y, pred) %>%
          mutate(
            fit = exp(fit),
            lwr = exp(lwr),
            upr = exp(upr)
          )})) %>%
  select(lake_name, prediction) %>%
  unnest(prediction)

# Create annotation labels
labels_lake <- stats_lake %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "a = ", signif(a, 3), "\n",
      "b = ", round(b, 3), "\n",
      "N = ", format(N, big.mark = ","), "\n",
      "R² = ", round(R2, 3)))

ggplot(data = Trawl_data_filtered_life_stage, 
       aes(x = fish_length_mm, y = calc_std_weight_g, fill = life_stage2)) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, shape = 21, colour = "black") +
  
  geom_ribbon(
  data = predictions_lake,
  aes(
    x = fish_length_mm,
    ymin = lwr,
    ymax = upr
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "grey50",
  alpha = 0.2) +
  
  geom_line(data = predictions_lake, aes(x = fish_length_mm, y = fit), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_text(data = labels_lake, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "B") +
  labs(x = "Length (mm)", y = "Weight (g)", fill = "Life stage") +
  labs(title="Stickleback Length/Weight Relations", subtitle = "Key Study Lakes, All Years") +
  facet_wrap(~lake_name, ncol = 4, scale = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill   = "yellow", #"#FBD424FF", 
                                    colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "bottom")

```

```{r trawl-sockeye-proportions, fig.cap="Annual proportion of Sockeye in Trawl data, weighted by number of fish in sample.", fig.width=fig_width, out.width=out_width, fig.height=half_height}

# Pre-process once
trawl_data_all_spp <- Trawl_data_import %>%
  fix_lake_codes_names() %>%
  filter(lake_name %in% lakes_of_interest) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(species_common_name),
    !is.na(fish_length_mm),
    !is.na(calc_std_weight_g),
    !(species_common_name == "Sockeye" & life_stage == "Adult") ) %>% # omit any Sockeye adults
  mutate(
    species_common_name = factor(species_common_name)) %>%
  arrange(lake_name, trawl_date)

trawl_sockeye_proportion <- trawl_data_all_spp %>%
  group_by(
    lake_name,
    lake_code,
    ats_year,
    trawl_date,
    trawl_number,
    trawl_unique_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_sockeye = sum(species_common_name == "Sockeye", na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_sockeye = n_sockeye / n_total,
   .groups = "drop")
  
trawl_annual_sockeye_proportion <- trawl_sockeye_proportion %>%
  group_by(
    lake_name,
    lake_code,
    ats_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trawls = n(),
    total_fish = sum(n_total),
    total_sockeye = sum(n_sockeye),
    weighted_mean_prop_sockeye =
      weighted.mean(
        prop_sockeye,
        w = n_total,
        na.rm = TRUE),
    median_prop_sockeye =
      median(prop_sockeye, na.rm = TRUE),
     .groups = "drop")

for (lk in sort(unique(trawl_sockeye_proportion$lake_name))) {

  survey_lk <- trawl_sockeye_proportion %>%
    filter(lake_name == lk)

  annual_lk <- trawl_annual_sockeye_proportion %>%
    filter(lake_name == lk)

  p <- ggplot(
    survey_lk,
  aes(
    x = factor(ats_year),
    y = prop_sockeye)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "yellow",
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(
    data = annual_lk,
    aes(
      x = factor(ats_year),
      y = weighted_mean_prop_sockeye,
      group = 1),
    colour = "red",
    linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = annual_lk,
    aes(
      x = factor(ats_year),
      y = weighted_mean_prop_sockeye
    ),
    colour = "red",
    size = 1) +
  # facet_wrap(
  #   ~ lake_name,
  #   scales = "free_x",
  #   ncol = 4
  # ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = paste(lk, "Sockeye Proportion in Trawl Samples"),
    subtitle = "Boxplots show trawl-level distributions; red line is the weighted annual mean",
    x = "",
    y = "Sockeye (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "yellow",
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3))

print(p)
}
